passages.title: Independent Gaussian complement and Jensen width bound
passages.inference: The PSD complement is constructed using its square root; its actual Gaussian law is independent under a product measure. Centering plus the proved independent-addition norm Jensen estimate gives width monotonicity, and exact covariance-sum law plus scaling gives gQ≤sqrt(4/3)gΣ. This final checkpoint follows the printed Jensen route; the earlier SF alternative is preserved only as checkpoint1 evidence.
